images.caption:
Schematic diagram showing the numbers of Teachtaí Dála by political party in the 31st Dáil. This is not an official seating diagram. Parties are identified by colours as follows:
Blue = Fine Gael
Red = Labour
Light green = Fianna Fáil
Dark green = Sinn Féin
Grey = Independents
Purple = People Before Profit Alliance
Orange = Socialist Party
Yellow = Ceann Comhairle
White = unassigned seats
